event.title: Swimmer Completes Challenge in Strait of Hormuz to Highlight Environmental Damage
event.canonical_title: Swimmer Completes Challenge in Strait of Hormuz to Highlight Environmental Damage
event.summary: British endurance swimmer Lewis Pugh completed a 15-kilometre swim through the Strait of Hormuz over three days in November 2026. The swim took place amid explosions and burning tankers, aiming to raise awareness about the environmental damage caused by the ongoing war with Iran.
